memory_candidates.content: Simpson1994 (Intuitionistic Modal Logic, LFCS ECS-LFCS-94-308) OCR PDF has page offset +9 (printed p.N = PDF p.N+9) and a text layer that is systematically defective at figures and displayed math while intact for prose. For any claim about a figure or displayed formula in this document, read the raster; the text layer silently drops symbols rather than erroring.

Before scoping a Lean inference-rule change as a 'mainline rewrite requiring re-proved soundness', measure the blast radius from the import graph rather than assuming it: `grep -rln <RelName> Cslib/` plus a check of which files import the defining module. A relation can be widely assumed to be load-bearing while actually being confined to its own subdirectory with a single induction over it. Same-named constructors in unrelated developments (e.g. Axiom.efq vs NIK.efq) inflate naive grep counts and can manufacture a false blast radius.

In labelled natural deduction (Simpson-style N_IK), a label-local (⊥E)/(∨E) recovers every cross-label instance whose labels are joined by a closure edge, with no frame axiom: label-local (⊥E) yields x:□A from x:⊥, and (□E) walks it across the edge; (∨E) runs the same trick one level up via y:□C. So k3 (◇⊥⊃⊥) and k4 (◇(A∨B)⊃◇A∨◇B) survive a label-local transcription at any theory with symmetry. The genuine gap is only the DISCONNECTED instances — which is exactly what Simpson's Prime Lemma 5.3.1 needs, since its Zorn target x:A is unrelated to the label being case-split.
